candidate_name: Santa Cruz de Tenerife LNG Terminal (Totisa Energía, Cueva Bermeja)
sponsor_or_proposer: Totisa Energía S.L.U. (parent: Totisa Holdings SA)
current_state: Concession application filed with the Santa Cruz de Tenerife Port Authority for 26,600 m2 at the Cueva Bermeja dock; the 'competencia de proyectos' (project-competition) phase has been cleared and the project is in environmental authorization (tramitacion ambiental). Scope: ~50,000 m3 fixed LNG storage in two tanks for ship supply, four gas/H2-blend engines totaling 70 MW captive power, and a modular green-H2 unit; ~EUR 100M. Originally targeted to operate in 2025 but not yet built or authorized as of mid-2026.
missing_threshold_elements: Threshold elements (sponsor + location + concrete step) are all met. Held on monitor rather than staged as a new_terminal on a SCOPE question: the facility is predominantly an LNG BUNKERING supply hub (project-wide excluded scope per methodology) plus captive power, not a conventional regasification/import terminal. Needs a human scope call on whether GEM tracks a fixed-storage bunkering+captive-power hub of this type. Distinct from the cancelled GEM 'Tenerife LNG Terminal' (T100000130537, Enagas, Granadilla de Abona) - different site, sponsor, and scope.
watch_for: Award of the administrative concession; positive/negative environmental impact declaration (DIA) from the Canary Islands Government (the parallel Las Palmas/Totisa project was killed by a negative DIA in 2024-2025); construction start; any reframing as a regasification/import terminal beyond bunkering.
